system.description:
Sounds Familiar. Roll your Luck Pool. Depending on the result, the Director gives you a story you remember that relates to your current predicament.

Wackjob (Flaw). Lose 1 Skill Die when trying to convince others.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.90
